Turn real-world objects into 3D models with just one photo. 🤯

Meet Camera to Blender — an open-source project that connects Tripo3D with Blender.

📸 Take a photo of any object using your phone. 🤖 Tripo3D converts it into a 3D model. ⚡ Click “Send to Blender” to import it directly into your connected Blender workspace.

⏱️ Generation takes around 30–60 seconds.

🔗 GitHub: https://github.com/ahujasid/camera-to-blender
